name: What is the return on investment for home modernization projects?

mainEntity.name: What is the return on investment for home modernization projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: The return on investment (ROI) for home modernization varies by project type and local market conditions. Kitchen and bathroom remodels, exterior improvements (like new siding or windows), and adding energy-efficient features often yield a strong ROI, sometimes recouping 70-85% or more of the cost at resale. Projects focused on personal enjoyment rather than broad appeal may have a lower financial ROI but a high lifestyle return. Simply Construction can advise on projects that typically offer good value in the Las Vegas market.
acceptedAnswer.description: ROI for home modernization depends on the project. Kitchens, bathrooms, and energy-efficient upgrades often have strong returns (70-85% or more) in the Las Vegas market.
